column1: # Donkey Kong Bananza (Switch 2, update v458752): Nintendo EPD's engine on NVN2, its shaders Ampere code (the translator's sm_86 frontend).
# Android emulator (arm64, API 35, Vulkan over MoltenVK, 2026-11-03): boots to the title menu, plays the opening and the mining tunnel with sound; all 23,638 shaders
# translate. The emulator draws no geometry shaders (the terrain's culling pass) nor pipelines past Metal's 16 samplers. Not tested on a device yet.
# Speed (emulator, handheld mode): 60 fps (frame p50 16.6 ms, p95 18-19 ms) further into the mining tunnel (1,100-2,200 draws), 30 fps at its start (~6,300
# draws). The game picks its present interval from the span from the end of one present step to the end of its draw, or to the frame's last GPU timestamp if
# later (main+0x203674; interval 1 under 20 ms). With the env below the CPU part is ~8 ms (it was ~30 with the pacing and the job system's waits in it); at
# the tunnel's start the replay (~7 ms) and the emulator's GPU (~11 ms) after the game's submission keep the GPU part over 20 ms. The env: the replay on its
# own thread with no wait at the acquire for it (the game waits on the last frame's fence before the next), the acquire's pacing in its sync
# (DM_NVN_ACQ_SYNC), and the job workers spinning before they sleep
